stories.headline: OpenAI Introduces GPT-6 Cyber Agent
stories.blurb: OpenAI released GPT-6 Cyber, an aligned AI agent created to advance frontier cybersecurity research and improve defensive capabilities.

stories.headline: Thinking Machines Lab Unveils Inkling 2 Small Following $5B Round
stories.blurb: Thinking Machines Lab released its new Inkling 2 Small model alongside news of a $5 billion funding round at a $40 billion valuation.

stories.headline: CNCF Accepts Open Infrastructure Framework for Autonomous Agents
stories.blurb: Google and community partners brought open cloud-native infrastructure standards for autonomous AI agents into the CNCF ecosystem.

stories.headline: Hugging Face Releases MoE Training Handbook
stories.blurb: Hugging Face published a comprehensive technical guide covering architectural design, optimization, and practical execution for training Mixture-of-Experts models.

stories.headline: Google Launches Open Source XLA Serving Engine
stories.blurb: Google introduced the XLA Serving Engine to significantly boost throughput and lower latency for compiler-accelerated LLM inference workloads.

stories.headline: OpenSSH Discloses Password Authentication Bypass Flaw
stories.blurb: Alpine Linux issued a security advisory detailing a password authentication bypass vulnerability in openssh-server that requires immediate patching.

stories.headline: Cloudflare Outlines Trusted Agent Delegation Architecture
stories.blurb: Cloudflare introduced a security model for managing identities and permissions when users delegate high-privilege tasks to AI agents.

stories.headline: Google TPU Hardware Challenges Nvidia in Inference Market
stories.blurb: New analysis highlights how Google's custom TPU platform is gaining significant market share for large-scale enterprise model inference.

stories.headline: METR Evaluates AI R&D Acceleration Risks at Anthropic
stories.blurb: Independent evaluator METR released an assessment analyzing how automated AI research tools accelerate engineering output and impact safety protocols at Anthropic.

stories.headline: Inside GitHub's Next-Generation Git Storage Architecture
stories.blurb: GitHub shared engineering details on its redesigned core storage layer built to handle massive scale and increase repository reliability.

stories.headline: Datadog Implements Continuous Formal Spec Validation in Production
stories.blurb: Datadog published how it continuously tests formal software specifications directly against running production infrastructure to catch architectural defects.

stories.headline: Docker Compares Sandboxes vs. Containers for AI Workloads
stories.blurb: Docker detailed the trade-offs between MicroVM-based sandboxes and traditional containers when isolating untrusted execution from autonomous agents.

stories.headline: Dropbox Plans Acquisition of Globally Distributed Object Store Tigris
stories.blurb: Dropbox announced an agreement to acquire developer-focused object storage startup Tigris to enhance its cloud storage backend infrastructure.
